captions.instagram:
Concept redesign of a fictional electrician. Not a client project.

When the power is out, you want two things fast: proof the electrician is licensed and a number to call. A lot of trade sites open with a stock light bulb, a long about-us paragraph and a Contact button that leads to another page.

So we put the licence number under the name, swapped the bulb for real job photos, listed the services in four short lines and kept a call button on screen the whole way down.

Does your site do this? Free review at prycedigital.com/book

captions.linkedin:
Concept redesign: a fictional electrician’s homepage, rebuilt for the phone.

The old version opens with a stock photo of a light bulb, then a long paragraph about being family owned and committed to quality. There is no licence number anywhere, and the phone number sits behind a Contact button.

The new one puts the licence number right under the business name, shows real job photos, lists the services in four plain lines, and keeps a call button on screen the whole way down.

Not a client project. If your trade site does any of this, I am happy to take a look: prycedigital.com/book
